tagline: Global leader in slurry pump technology and engineered solutions for mining and infrastructure
hero_kpi_rationale: The KPI reflects continuous innovation in Warman MC pumps, a cornerstone of product leadership. Weir Minerals invests 1.3% of global sales in R&D to maintain its technological advantage in grinding circuit pumps, a key mining market segment. This investment funds the development of exclusive innovations such as adjustable throatbush, pre-rotation impellers, and high-performance materials (Ultrachrome A05, Hyperchrome A61, R55 rubber).
